name: Extract Power
oracle_text: Look at the top card of each player's library, then exile those cards face down. You may play them without paying their mana costs for as long as they remain exiled.
blocked_sentences: Look at the top card of each player's library, then exile those cards face down. You may play them without paying their mana costs for as long as they remain exiled.

needs.what: a lasting permission on exiled cards (duration while_exiled) to PLAY them -- cast a spell or play a land -- without paying their mana costs, granted to the spell's controller even for cards exiled from an opponent's library; e.g. a `playable_free: true` option on `look_at_top`/`exile`/`grant_playable` that sets the object's playable_free flag, with playable_by set to the effect's controller rather than the library owner
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `look_at_top` with `player: each_player`, `destination: exile`, `face_down` and `playable: while_exiled` gets the exile right, but `_move_found` writes `playable_by` as the library's owner (so the opponent, not you, could play their own card) and nothing sets the free-cast flag: `playable_free` is only written by plot. `cast_free` on `look_at_top`/`exile_until` is a one-shot cast during resolution that excludes lands, not a lasting permission to play them later; `grant_playable` has no free option
